title: Determine the initial and subsequent measurement of indefinite life intangible assets and goodwill

items.concept: Initial recognition JE for acquisition (goodwill residual + indefinite trademark/IPR&D); subsequent carrying-amount schedule (no amortization); disposal of indefinite-life trademark
Number-variant twin: initial recognition of goodwill and indefinite-life intangibles; zero-amortization subsequent schedule; disposal with gain
Crypto indefinite-life intangible at cost then period-end fair-value remeasurement; standalone indefinite trademark at cost with no amortization
Classification of subsequent measurement — amortize finite patent only; not trademark, IPR&D, or goodwill (public)
Initial recognition — compute residual goodwill from purchase price and FV of identifiable net assets
